Cartridge GPL header.description: Standard cartridge header at >6000 with one menu entry. xas99 -c will skip adding its own header when it finds this.
body: PROG   DATA >0000                * No next menu item
BYTE ${2:8}                     * Length of the menu text

Workspace setup.description: Point the workspace at scratchpad RAM. >8300 is not multiplexed, so register access avoids the 4-cycle wait state.
body: WRKSP  EQU  >${1:8300}              * Workspace in scratchpad RAM
${2:MAIN}   LIMI 0                    * Interrupts off while we set up

VDP register write.description: Write one VDP register directly through the ports, no E/A utilities needed.
body: LI   R0,>${1:80}${2:00}              * Register ${1} in the high byte, value in the low
ORI  R0,>8000             * Set the register-write bits

VDP register table load.description: Load all eight VDP registers from a byte table. This is the loop used in most cartridge start-up code.
body: LI   R1,REGLD             * Point at the value table
LI   R2,>8000             * Register 0, write bit set

VDP write address.description: Set the VDP address counter for a write. Low byte first, then the high byte with bit 6 set.
body: ORI  R0,>4000             * Bit 14 marks a write

VSBW single byte write.description: Editor/Assembler single byte VDP write. Requires REF VSBW.
body: LI   R1,${2:>2000}              * Character in the high byte

VMBW multiple byte write.description: Editor/Assembler multiple byte VDP write. Requires REF VMBW.

Clear the screen.description: Fill the 24x32 screen image table with a single character.
body: LI   R1,${1:>2000}              * Space character in the high byte
CLRLP  MOVB R1,@>8C00            * Write to VDP data port

Keyboard scan.description: Scan the keyboard through the E/A utility. Requires REF KSCAN.
body: MOVB R0,@>8374            * Unit 0: scan the whole keyboard
MOVB @>8375,R1            * Key code in the high byte

Subroutine with BL.description: BL subroutine. R11 holds the return address, so nested calls must save it.
body: ${1:NAME}   MOV  R11,@${1:NAME}RT           * Save the return address

Delay loop.description: Busy-wait delay. Roughly 14 cycles per inner iteration at 3 MHz.

Sprite attribute entry.description: One entry in the sprite attribute list: Y, X, pattern, colour. Y=>D0 terminates the list.

Module with DEF and REF.description: Separately assembled module exporting one entry point.

E/A option 5 program.description: Editor/Assembler option 5 image. SFIRST and SLAST bound the saved memory range.
body: B    @>0070               * Return to the E/A menu

Data table.description: Word table with a computed length constant.

Text with length prefix.description: Text constant with a length symbol, ready for VMBW.
